lessons: Parallel analysis prevents narratively convenient over-retention of covariance modes.
Signed poles must be evaluated separately because activation, duration, and XAU manifestation are asymmetric.
A conservative next-session convention reduces EOD look-ahead but does not prove point-in-time availability without release/vintage evidence.
Stable latent structure does not imply causal structure.
Contemporaneous explanation and forward association answer different questions and must remain separate.
Restricted inputs can contribute aggregate evidence without persisting source observations.
